text.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
text.body_text: - Published A Mexican drug lord who was on the FBI's 10 most wanted list has been arrested following a shoot-out with Mexican authorities. Fausto Isidro "Chapo Isidro" Meza Flores was detained along with his lieutenant by Mexican special forces in Guasave, Sinaloa on Friday, Mexico's defence secretariat said. Meza Flores was wanted in Mexico on organised crime charges, while…
text.summary: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores, who is accused of drug trafficking and torture, is detained after gun fight with authorities.

audio.title: Government Funding Pressure On Iran War, National Security & Tech, Iowa Detonation
audio.description: Democrats are weighing whether to use the government funding deadline to cut off money for the war in Iran, exposing divisions over how quickly the party should act. The Trump administration approved sales of advanced U.S. chips to Chinese companies, including some the Pentagon has linked to China’s military, fueling a debate over whether those sales help America compete or create new security risks. The Army delayed plans to destroy thousands of pounds of unstable bomb-making material in Iowa after public pressure and a lawsuit, even as officials warn colder weather could make it more dangerous. text.title: International UN talks on controlling use of autonomous weapons collapse
text.body_text: Week-long efforts to agree a negotiating mandate for a legally binding international treaty to control the use of autonomous weapons collapsed just before 5am after all-night talks failed to overcome Russian objections.…
text.summary: Week-long efforts fail to establish negotiating mandate on AI warfare after Russian ‘filibustering’ Week-long efforts to agree a negotiating mandate for a legally binding international treaty to control the use of autonomous weapons collapsed just before 5am after all-night talks failed to overcome Russian objections. Despite an overwhelming majority of states at the UN’s Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW) in Geneva wanting to agree a negotiating mandate leading to a legally binding treaty, the need for consensus forced the conference to adopt a much weaker option. audio.title: Our Island Story, Part 2 - The Red Rose and the White
audio.description: Our Island Story, Part 2 by . Our Island Story was first published in 1905 and became an instant classic. Beginning with the Romans and following the triumphs and foibles of the good, not so good and the downright despicable figures of history; we are treated to a dazzling montage of kings, queens, barons, knights, explorers, movers and shakers that have played a key role in the history of England
